question: What do I pay for every month?
title: What repeats every month

cells.title: Bills and subscriptions, one definition
cells.code:
PENSION = (me.get("age") or 0) >= 68
PAY = "pension day" if PENSION else "payday"
PAY_TO = "pension day" if PENSION else "payday"
CYCLE = "pension cycle" if PENSION else "pay cycle"
def day(s):
    d = datetime.date.fromisoformat(str(s)[:10])
    return f"{d.day} {d:%b}"
emit("pay_word", PAY, "text", "The day money comes in")
emit("pay_to", PAY_TO, "text", "The day money comes in")

p = kori.repeating()
rows = [{"what": b["what"], "per_month": b["per_month"], "kind": "a bill, at your usual month"} for b in p.get("bills") or []]
rows += [{"what": x["what"], "per_month": x["per_month"], "kind": "looks like a subscription"} for x in p.get("subscriptions") or []]
if rows and abs(sum(r["per_month"] for r in rows) - p["total_per_month"]) < 0.005:
    n = p["subscription_count"]
    emit("total_per_month", p["total_per_month"], "eur_per_month", "Repeats a month")
    emit("subscription_count", n, "count", "Subscriptions found")
    emit("definition", p["definition"], "text", "What counts as repeating")
    emit("note", p["note"], "text", "What the bank can see")
    table("repeating", rows, "Payments that repeat, last 12 months")
    say(f"No subscriptions show on this account over the last 12 months. What repeats is your bills: **{eur(p['total_per_month'], True)}** a month." if n == 0 else f"Over the last 12 months, your bills and {n} {'subscription' if n == 1 else 'subscriptions'} repeat every month: **{eur(p['total_per_month'], True)}** a month in all.")
